content: Executable-doc verification precedents: Python doctest executes interactive examples embedded in docs to verify they work as shown ('literate testing'/'executable documentation'). Research: LLM-generated test-case executability ranges 70-90% by complexity; executability (runs without manual edits) and validity (correct behavior) are distinct binary metrics. A patent describes 'validation via simulation' — automatically executing each step of a generated help article in the target app, checking app state after each step to confirm the next step is reachable. Mintlify's install-md standardizes 'DONE WHEN' measurable success criteria + verification commands so agents can prove an install actually worked. No mainstream drafting tool gates 'done' on proving steps run — this is the differentiator and is genuinely hard.
